payload.name: Information Scent in Visual Search
payload.fact: Strong information scent improves visual search performance in hyperbolic tree browsers, while target crowding in compressed regions degrades performance, particularly when scent is weak.
payload.boundary: Visual search in hyperbolic tree browsers

provenance.title: The effects of information scent on visual search in the hyperbolic tree browser
provenance.quote_or_locus: Two processes appear to affect visual search in the Hyperbolic display: strong information scent improves visual search, and the crowding of targets in a compressed region degrades visual search especially when there is weak information scent
